content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a couple of adjustments before signing. - Regarding the clause stating: "For avoidance of doubt, payments will be made only after receiving exemption from tax deduction approval from the tax authority in Israel. Delay in payment as a result of not receiving such exemption will not constitute late payment or breach hereunder.", your payment depends on an outside tax authority's approval, meaning you could face indefinite payment delays without it being considered a breach. Therefore, I propose that "Payments shall be made in accordance with the agreed terms regardless of tax exemption approvals from local authorities.". Best regards.
